source_mechanisms: Trainer constructs all20 providers, seals every original block and writes the observation barrier before any TRAIN truth join, model initialization or optimizer update.
The required first seal covers3089 blocks,98516 complete marginal trees,254141098 node appearances and303833 sites. This is substantial CPU/NFS preparation before useful GPU training.
The original seal calls _read directly, bypassing cache insertion, and release clears both main LRU and worker source state.

Each original parent update's forward/reverse scans and backward recomputation request identical deterministic CPU feature banks repeatedly; the512MiB LRU handles immediate adjacent get reuse and some scan-turn reuse but is cleared after every parent.

Both persistent workers are rebound620 times:20 required seals plus600 updates. On a cache miss their fresh parent Dataset state hashes/opens original tree/genotype/positions/allele/focal payloads before feature construction.

Worker _read hashes the complete bank, the main receiver verifies the transport hash, and every cache get hashes again. Original row-only and checkpoint get calls also repeat the cache hash. The new route retains these scientific content checks rather than trusting a cache hit.

The fast runtime callback performs current expiry/RSS/GPU lease/title/job checks. Persistent receive loops repeat it every<=0.1s while waiting. It has no storage scan or journal call; repeated lease/path syscalls can cost NFS latency, while full feature reconstruction is the large removable work.

The new cache captures the original checked CPU banks during the mandatory seal, retains them through all600 updates, and rejects a post-seal cache miss. All620 worker context binds/releases still occur, but training cache hits dispatch no worker feature task.

Only raw deterministic CPU features are cached. Weight-dependent encode_bank/GRU outputs, full BPTT, checkpoint recomputation, FP32 losses/gradients/optimizer order, checkpoints and all30 heldout seals remain unchanged.
